_comment: Sanitized from a real Stripe sandbox response (GET /v2/core/accounts/{id}, Stripe-Version 2025-12-15.clover, include configuration.recipient and requirements, restricted rk_test_ key). Only the fields Felyn reads, as reported; the account id is replaced, and the email, names, identity data, dates, metadata and Stripe's error text are left out. Fields not reported (requirements.summary, entries[].reference, entries[].requested_reasons) are omitted rather than guessed.
